title: Meta agrees to allow rival "general purpose AI chatbots" access to WhatsApp in Europe for a 12-month period to avoid potential interim measures from the EU (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
summary: Foo Yun Chee / Reuters: Meta agrees to allow rival “general purpose AI chatbots” access to WhatsApp in Europe for a 12-month period to avoid potential interim measures from the EU — Artificial intelligence rivals will be allowed on WhatsApp for a year, Meta Platforms (META.O) said …
contentText:
Foo Yun Chee / Reuters :

Meta agrees to let rival “general purpose AI chatbots” access WhatsApp for a fee in Europe for a 12-month period to avoid potential interim measures from the EU   —  Artificial intelligence rivals will be allowed on WhatsApp for a year, Meta Platforms (META.O) said …
